narrative_goal: Show that from 2011 to 2017 the audit rate for Americans earning $500K or more fell sharply from 8.0% to 2.5%, while the audit rate for those earning under $25K stayed nearly flat, declining only from 1.2% to 0.8%.
intent_en: Compare how tax audit rates changed from 2011 to 2017 across the four income groups, including the highest-income group and the lowest-income group.
